card.text: TOI-1431 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "TOI-1431 b"
sources.quote: TOI-1431 b, also known as MASCARA-5b, is an ultra-hot Jupiter exoplanet orbiting TOI-1431 in the constellation of Cepheus.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around TOI-1431. Its orbit and size follow Addison et al. 2021's fit, the archive's default.

sources.quote: It has an orbital period of 2.7 days.

thermal.title: Estimated heat
thermal.summary: Not measured: the color of a black body at the 2,370 K its paper computes from its star's light.

temperature.title: TESS heat map
temperature.summary: Heat across 0.6–1 µm from the paper's phase-curve fit. It varies only with longitude: the data hold no north-south detail.
